state.unreadable: {path} cannot be read. Choose another folder or delete that file.
state.newer_format: {path} was written by a newer installer. Use that installer or another folder.
state.output_changed: Installed files of step '{step}' changed since they were made; that step runs again.
check.romfs_files_wrong: The RomFS files in {path} are not those of game version {version}: {bad} of {total} differ and {missing} are missing. Dump the RomFS again with the {version} update installed.
check.exefs_wrong_version: The exefs folder ({path}) is not the code of update {wanted}.
check.romfs_no_table: This release has no file list for game version {version}, so it cannot use a RomFS of loose files. Use the RomFS image (romfs.bin) or the NSP/XCI files.
check.release_incomplete: The installer folder is incomplete; missing: {paths}. Unpack the release again.
check.dest_not_folder: The install location {path} is a file, not a folder.
check.dest_not_empty: The install folder {path} is not empty and holds no earlier installation. Choose an empty folder.
check.toolchain_broken: The bundled compiler does not work: {detail}
check.glibc_old: This system's C library is glibc {version}; the setup's compiler needs {need} or later (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, Fedora 35, SteamOS 3 and newer have it). Updating the system fixes this.
check.host_probe_failed: The computer check did not run (exit code {code}).
check.cpu_no_avx2: This processor lacks AVX2 (x86-64-v3), which the game needs. Intel Haswell (2013) or AMD Excavator / Zen and newer have it.
check.cpu_too_old: This processor is too old for the game: it lacks SSE4.2 and POPCNT (x86-64-v2). Intel Nehalem (2008) or AMD Bulldozer (2011) and newer have them.
check.vulkan_missing: No Vulkan driver is installed. Install the latest driver for your graphics card.
check.vulkan_no_device: Vulkan finds no graphics card. Install the latest driver for your graphics card.
check.vulkan_too_old: The game needs a graphics card with Vulkan 1.3; found: {devices}. Update the graphics driver.
check.inputs_needed: The game files are needed: choose the base game, the 2.0.0 update and prod.keys.
check.game_no_base: No base game (XCI, NSP, XCZ or NSZ) was found in {path}.
check.game_no_update: No 2.0.0 update (NSP or NSZ) was found in {path}.
check.keys_unreadable: The keys file cannot be read. Choose a prod.keys file.
check.keys_no_header_key: The keys file has no header_key. Dump prod.keys from your console again.
check.keys_title_keys: This keys file is title.keys, which the setup does not use. Pick prod.keys instead: it comes from the same console dump and holds header_key and the other keys that open the game files.
check.keys_wrong: The keys cannot open the {input} file. Use the prod.keys of your console.
check.keys_too_old: The keys file is too old for the {input} file (needs key generation {generation}). Dump prod.keys from a console with newer firmware.
check.not_game_file: The {input} file is not an XCI, NSP, XCZ or NSZ game file.
check.ticket_personalized: The {input} file carries a personalized ticket; a common ticket is needed.
check.ticket_missing: The {input} file lacks the ticket its content needs.
check.update_not_nsp: The update must be an NSP or NSZ file.
check.base_not_game: The base game file is not Xenoblade Chronicles X: Definitive Edition ({detail}).
check.update_is_base: The update file holds a base game. Choose the 2.0.0 update NSP.
check.update_not_game: The update file is not an update of Xenoblade Chronicles X: Definitive Edition ({detail}).
check.dlc_not_game: {path} holds no add-on content of Xenoblade Chronicles X: Definitive Edition.
check.exefs_failed: The game code of the {input} file failed its checks; see {log}.
check.input_damaged: The {input} file is damaged or incomplete: {path} ({detail}). Copy that file again from its source, or dump it again, then run the setup again.
check.base_wrong_version: The base game is not version 1.0.0 ({modules} differ).
check.update_wrong_version: The update is version {found}; this release takes {wanted}.
check.disk_space: Not enough free space for {path}: {need_gb} GB needed, {free_gb} GB free.
extract.exefs_mismatch: The extracted game code does not match version {version} ({modules}).
extract.romfs_merge_failed: Applying the update to the game data failed: {detail}. Details: {log}
extract.romfs_mismatch: The extracted game data does not match version {version} (size {size}, checksum {sha256}...).
lift.failed: Translating the game code failed (exit code {code}). Details: {log}
dlc.extract_failed: The add-on content in {path} cannot be extracted. Details: {log}
compile.exe_in_use: {path} is in use. Close the game and run the installer again.
warn.lang_needs_fonts: Text in {lang} needs the Switch system fonts, which the installer does not extract; some text may not show.
warn.npdm_differs: main.npdm differs from the reference {version} dump; only the code modules are used.
warn.kernel_old: Linux {version} lacks the write tracking the game relies on (6.7 or later); the game may run very slowly. Updating the system fixes this.
warn.cpu_no_avx2: This processor lacks AVX2, so the game is built for older processors (x86-64-v2) and runs slower than on a processor with AVX2.
warn.cheats_skipped: The cheats of the mods folder could not be built in; the game is built without its code cheats. Details: {log}
ui.title: XCX Setup
ui.intro: Builds a playable Xenoblade Chronicles X: Definitive Edition folder from your own game files. This takes a while and runs once.
ui.notice: The folder this setup builds contains the game. It is for your own use only; do not share or upload it.
ui.keys_private: The keys file is read in place. Its contents are never shown, copied or stored.
ui.base: Base game (NSP, XCI, NSZ or XCZ)
ui.update_mode: This folder holds an earlier installation. The setup continues or updates it; the game files are asked for only if they are needed again.
ui.missing_base: The base game file does not exist.
ui.missing_update: The update file does not exist.
ui.missing_dlc: The add-on content file was not found.
ui.missing_keys: The keys file does not exist.
ui.done_text: Start {game_exe} from {dest}. The setup program and the game files you chose are no longer needed.
ui.cancelled_text: The finished steps are kept. Start the setup again with the same folder to continue.
ui.confirm_cancel: The setup is running. Cancel it and close the window?
ui.space_one: Free space needed on {path}: {need} GB (free: {free} GB).
ui.space_two: Free space needed on {path}: {need} GB (free: {free} GB); on {temp}: {temp_need} GB (free: {temp_free} GB).
launcher.title: XCX Setup
launcher.python_missing: The setup files are incomplete: the python folder next to XCX-Setup.exe is missing. Unpack the whole archive again and start XCX-Setup.exe from the unpacked folder.
phase.dlss.download: Downloading nvngx_dlss.dll from NVIDIA's DLSS SDK
warn.dlss_kept: A DLSS library is already in the install folder ({path}); the setup keeps it.
warn.dlss_file_wrong: {path} is not NVIDIA's nvngx_dlss.dll {version} (SHA-256 {sha}...), so the setup did not copy it. The game runs without DLSS.
warn.dlss_download_failed: NVIDIA DLSS could not be downloaded from {url}: {detail}. The game runs without it; the next setup run tries again.
ui.dlss: Download NVIDIA DLSS (nvngx_dlss.dll) for NVIDIA RTX graphics cards
ui.dlss_help: From NVIDIA's DLSS SDK on GitHub, under NVIDIA's RTX SDK license (github.com/NVIDIA/DLSS). It makes the DLSS upscaler setting work; without it the game uses FSR instead.
ui.mods_need_install: Pick the install folder of the game (the one with {game_exe}) first, then choose Mods.
mods.title: XCX Recomp mods
mods.intro: Mods in {dest}\mods. Game-file mods switch while the game runs and apply the next time it loads the file; Lua mods apply when the game starts. Your saves are not touched.
mods.pick: Select a mod to see what it does.
mods.lua_restart: Lua mods apply the next time the game starts.
mods.confirm_download: Download {name} ({size} MB) from its author's page, {url}?
mods.confirm_remove: Remove {name}? A save made with it can lose missions or items the mod added.
mods.offline: The mod library could not be reached; installed mods are listed and can still be switched.
mods.index_failed: The mod library could not be read: {detail}
mods.index_format: The mod library has a format this setup does not know; a newer XCX Recomp release reads it.
mods.bad_link: The mod's download link is not https: {url}
mods.download_mismatch: The download from {url} is not the file the library lists (size or SHA-256 differ). The author may have uploaded a new version; nothing was installed.
mods.zip_bad: The zip could not be opened: {detail}
mods.zip_unsafe: The zip has an unsafe entry ({name}); nothing was installed.
mods.zip_no_romfs: The zip has no romfs folder, so it holds no game files XCX Recomp can use.
mods.zip_too_big: The zip unpacks to more than 16 GB.
mods.zip_other_game: The zip is made for another game (title ID {title}); nothing was installed.
mods.moved: "{folder}" in the mods folder is now the mod {id}. Turn it on to use it.
mods.skip_zip: {folder} in the mods folder is not read: unpack it there, or add it with Add zip.
mods.skip_lua_name: "{folder}" in the mods folder is not read: a Lua mod's folder name may have only lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'.
mods.skip_no_romfs: "{folder}" in the mods folder is not read: it has no romfs folder or mod.ini.
mods.skip_two_romfs: "{folder}" in the mods folder is not read: it has more than one romfs folder. Put each mod in a folder of its own.
mods.skip_other_game: "{folder}" in the mods folder is not read: it is made for another game (title ID {title}).
mods.skip_move_failed: "{folder}" in the mods folder could not be moved to the layout the game reads: {detail}
mods.bad_id: "{id}" is not a usable mod name: rename the zip to start with a letter.
mods.not_in_library: {id} is not in the mod library.
